question: During which period did the Sultanate ruler, Ghiyas-ud-din Balban, take over and rule the throne of Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is **1266-1287**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghiyas-ud-din Balban** was one of the most powerful rulers of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• He ruled from **1266 to 1287**, following the death of Sultan Nasir-ud-din Mahmud.
 
• Balban is known for his strong centralized administration and military reforms.
 
• He implemented a policy of iron-fisted governance to consolidate his rule and suppress rebellions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Early Life**
 Balban was originally a Turkish slave who rose to prominence in the court of Sultan Iltutmish.
 
 

 **Military Reforms**
 He reorganized the army and established a strong military presence to defend the Sultanate.
 
 

 **Administrative Reforms**
 He centralized administration and established a system of efficient governance.
 
 

 **Suppression of Nobles**
 Balban crushed the power of the Turkish nobles to establish his supremacy.
 
 

 **Legacy**
 He left a legacy of strong centralized rule, which was followed by his successors.
